title: Dhaani: A Data-Flow-Driven Tool for Greenfield Construction and Brownfield Modernisation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28798v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can generate plausible code quickly, but an end-to-end prompt leaves developers with little control over decomposition, interfaces, or the assumptions that must survive later revisions. We present Dhaani, a free desktop application for greenfield program construction and brownfield repository modernisation. It makes an annotated data-flow diagram (ADFD) the inspectable contract between intent and implementation. In the greenfield workflow, Build, a user turns natural-language requirements into a typed graph, reviews process specifications and pre/post-conditions, ratifies generated modules, and proceeds in dependency order for Python or .NET (C#). In the brownfield workflow, Migrate uses source inference to recover an ADFD from a Fortran repository, performs target generation in bounded dependency groups, and exposes source-target alignment, generated code, errors, time, token use, and cost. translated_title: Dhaani：一个面向全新程序构建与存量系统现代化的数据流驱动工具
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28798v1 公告类型：new 摘要：大语言模型能够快速生成看似合理的代码，但端到端的提示方式使开发人员几乎无法控制任务分解、接口设计，以及那些必须在后续修订中得以保留的假设。我们提出了 Dhaani，这是一款用于全新（greenfield）程序构建与存量（brownfield）代码库现代化的免费桌面应用程序。该工具将带注释的数据流图（ADFD）作为意图与实现之间可供审查的契约。在全新构建工作流 Build 中，用户将自然语言需求转换为类型化图，审查过程规范及前置/后置条件，批准生成的模块，并按依赖顺序完成 Python 或 .NET（C#）的开发。在存量迁移工作流 Migrate 中，工具通过源代码推断从 Fortran 代码库中恢复出 ADFD，在有界依赖组内执行目标代码生成，并展示源代码与目标代码的对齐关系、生成的代码、错误信息、耗时、token 用量以及成本。该工具保持代码与（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Dhaani 是一款以带注释数据流图（ADFD）作为意图与实现之间可审查契约的免费桌面工具，支持将自然语言需求按依赖顺序构建为全新 Python/.NET 程序，并能从 Fortran 存量代码库迁移生成现代化代码。
en_tdlr: Dhaani is a free desktop tool that uses annotated data-flow diagrams (ADFD) as inspectable contracts between intent and implementation, enabling greenfield construction of Python/.NET programs from natural-language requirements and modernisation of legacy Fortran repositories.
